# Changelog

Notable changes to this repository are recorded here from 02/09/2026 onward.
Earlier work is verifiable in the commit history and in the closed pull
requests.

This repository is **not versioned**: it publishes the personal profile of
`lcv-leo` and the static site at lcv-leo.lcv.dev. It does not publish packages
or a numbered artifact. Entries are grouped by date rather than semantic
version. Dates are written `DD/MM/AAAA` in Brasília time (UTC−03:00).

## Unreleased

- Align the `THIRDPARTY.md` license link for the official Claude Code Action
  with its pinned v1.0.271 release commit SHA (LCV-619).

- Correct the master text's Section 7.C intake-routing rule in `AGENTS.md` and
  `CLAUDE.md`: the exactly-one-Team-or-template invariant applies to addresses
  of type `team`, `template`, and `asks`; Linear's official documentation
  proves that `asksWeb` web-form addresses carry no Team/Template field by
  platform design (the form routes through its page and template, and the API
  refuses updates on them), so an `asksWeb` address with null team and null
  template is valid — never a finding or a pendency. This closes the external
  pendency that held the daily audits at PARTIAL since LCV-604, proven
  10/11/2026 under LCV-619.

- Align `.github/dependabot.yml` with the fleet standard: each `package-ecosystem`
  block keeps its `cooldown` configured (`default-days: 7`) but now excludes every
  dependency (`exclude: "*"`), so version updates are proposed immediately instead
  of observing the seven-day delay. The previous partial exclusion
  (`actions/*`, `github/*`) is replaced by the whole-ecosystem `*`, matching every
  organization repository and the master text's External Actions rule. The
  `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `SECURITY.md` cooldown prose is corrected to the same
  wording, and `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` Section 7.A carries the corrected External
  Actions rule (LCV-619).

- Align the `THIRDPARTY.md` license link for the official CodeQL SARIF upload
  Action with its pinned v4.39.3 release commit SHA (LCV-574).
